lines.zh: 背上的架子咯吱作响。
lines.en: The rack on my back creaks with every move.

lines.zh: 我一只眼看路，够用了。
lines.en: I watch the road with one eye, and that is enough.

lines.zh: 金剑垂在手边，盾牌挡住瞎眼那侧。
lines.en: My gold sword hangs ready, my shield guarding my blind side.

lines.zh: 我在黑石路上找可以换的东西。
lines.en: I search the blackstone road for things worth trading.

lines.zh: 马骨在我胯下响，那是匹凋灵骷髅马。
lines.en: Bones rattle under me; that is a wither skeleton horse.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，架子太重。
lines.en: I walk slowly, because the rack is heavy.

lines.zh: 空着的那只眼，能看见箭从哪来。
lines.en: My empty eye socket can tell where arrows come from.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩过熔岩边的碎石。
lines.en: My hooves cross the gravel beside the lava.

lines.zh: 我沿着堡垒外墙巡，找落单的猪灵。
lines.en: I patrol the outer wall, hunting for lone piglins.

lines.zh: 金剑不亮，我却擦得很勤。
lines.en: My gold sword is dull, yet I polish it often.

lines.zh: 架子上的钩子碰着砖，叮当响。
lines.en: The hooks on my rack clink against the brick.

lines.zh: 我绕开猪灵蛮兵的视线。
lines.en: I keep out of the piglin brutes' line of sight.

lines.zh: 我站着，架子把影子撑得很宽。
lines.en: I stand still, and the rack spreads my shadow wide.

lines.zh: 瞎眼那边有风，我侧头去听。
lines.en: Wind moves past my blind side, so I tilt my head to listen.

lines.zh: 盾牌边缘磨秃了，我还没换。
lines.en: The shield rim is worn smooth, and I have not replaced it.

lines.zh: 金剑在手里，我不会放下。
lines.en: The gold sword stays in my hand; I will not set it down.

lines.zh: 我数着架子上的钩子，一共七只。
lines.en: I count the hooks on my rack; there are seven.

lines.zh: 猪灵蛮兵从我身边过，我不抬头。
lines.en: A piglin brute passes me, and I do not look up.

lines.zh: 我盯着远处的弩手，慢慢眨眼。
lines.en: I stare at the distant crossbowman and blink slowly.

lines.zh: 骨头马在身后刨地，等得不耐烦。
lines.en: The bone horse paws the ground behind me, impatient.

lines.zh: 我把盾牌转了个面，露出划痕。
lines.en: I turn the shield over and show its scratches.

lines.zh: 这只眼酸了，可我不敢闭。
lines.en: My one eye aches, but I do not dare close it.

lines.zh: 你站的方向太正，我一只眼就够看。
lines.en: You stand straight ahead, so one eye is plenty.

lines.zh: 你要交易？先把武器放低。
lines.en: You want to trade? Lower your weapon first.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，瞎的那侧朝着墙。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you, blind side toward the wall.

lines.zh: 你袖口沾着金粉，我闻得到。
lines.en: There is gold dust on your cuff; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 你想摸我背上的架子？
lines.en: You want to touch the rack on my back?

lines.zh: 你的手指在剑柄上，我数过了。
lines.en: Your fingers rest on the hilt, and I have counted them.

lines.zh: 你从我瞎眼那边绕，我听见了。
lines.en: You slipped around my blind side, and I heard you.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾着主世界的泥。
lines.en: Your boots are caked with Overworld mud.

lines.zh: 金剑在你胸前比了比，我放下。
lines.en: I measure you with my gold sword, then lower it.

lines.zh: 别站在我弩手朋友的射线上。
lines.en: Do not stand in my crossbow friend's line of fire.

lines.zh: 箭擦过瞎眼那侧，我歪头。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my blind side, and I jerk my head away.

lines.zh: 金剑差点脱手，我抓紧了。
lines.en: My gold sword nearly flew off, but I held on.

lines.zh: 盾牌替我挨了一下，凹进去。
lines.en: The shield took that blow for me and dented inward.

lines.zh: 我退半步，架子撞在墙上。
lines.en: I step back, and the rack slams into the wall.

lines.zh: 你砍中我的腿，我单膝跪下。
lines.en: You cut my leg, and I drop to one knee.

lines.zh: 疼，但我只剩一只眼要护。
lines.en: It hurts, but I have only one eye left to protect.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子在地上滑了一下。
lines.en: My hooves slid once across the stone floor.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的钩子掉了两只。
lines.en: That hit knocked two hooks off my rack.

lines.zh: 伤口在渗血，我用盾牌压住。
lines.en: The wound is seeping, so I press my shield against it.

lines.zh: 骨头马嘶了一声，比我还急。
lines.en: The bone horse shrieks, more anxious than I am.

lines.zh: 我不吃你手里的东西，我换。
lines.en: I do not eat what you hold; I trade for it.

lines.zh: 金锭拿出来，别拿胡萝卜。
lines.en: Bring out a gold ingot, not a carrot.

lines.zh: 你把食物收好，交易只认金。
lines.en: Put the food away; my trades only take gold.

lines.zh: 我这只眼看不见面包，只看见金色。
lines.en: This eye sees no bread, only the color gold.

lines.zh: 食物留给你自己，主世界的人爱饿。
lines.en: Keep the food; Overworld folk are always hungry.

lines.zh: 我要的是能换的，不是能吃的。
lines.en: I want what can be traded, not what can be eaten.

lines.zh: 你举着肉，我举着金剑，各退一步。
lines.en: You raise meat, I raise gold; we both step back.

lines.zh: 猪灵不吃熟食，你记错了。
lines.en: Piglins do not eat cooked food; you remember it wrong.

lines.zh: 那块肉在冒热气，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: That meat is steaming, and I have no interest.

lines.zh: 你把食物放下，我才跟你谈。
lines.en: Set the food down, and then we can talk.

lines.zh: 架子的角挂住了你的披风。
lines.en: A corner of my rack snags your cloak.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，是因为你挡了路。
lines.en: I bump you because you are blocking my path.

lines.zh: 骨头马的鼻子顶到你背后了。
lines.en: The bone horse's nose nudges you from behind.

lines.zh: 盾牌磕到你，我不是故意的。
lines.en: My shield knocked you; that was not on purpose.

lines.zh: 我们离太近，架子转不开。
lines.en: We are too close, and my rack cannot turn.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的蹄印，我回头。
lines.en: You stepped on my hoofprint, so I look back.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你的护甲凹了一块。
lines.en: That collision left a dent in your armor.

lines.zh: 我瞎的那侧没看见你，抱歉。
lines.en: My blind side did not see you; my apologies.

lines.zh: 别从后面靠近，架子会响。
lines.en: Do not approach from behind; the rack gives you away.

lines.zh: 我们挤在门洞，谁也过不去。
lines.en: We are wedged in the doorway, and neither can pass.

lines.zh: 我的架子是给猎物用的，不是家什。
lines.en: This rack is for game, not for a household.

lines.zh: 猪灵猎人不成对出门。
lines.en: Piglin hunters do not travel in pairs.

lines.zh: 我这只瞎眼，没谁愿意看。
lines.en: Few want to look at this blind eye of mine.

lines.zh: 骨头马比同伴更靠得住。
lines.en: The bone horse is more reliable than any comrade.

lines.zh: 繁殖的事，交给庄园里的猪灵。
lines.en: Leave breeding to the piglins back at the manor.

lines.zh: 我连自己的窝都没有。
lines.en: I do not even have a den of my own.

lines.zh: 金剑会传给下一个猎人，不是孩子。
lines.en: My gold sword passes to the next hunter, not a child.

lines.zh: 我们这一行，活不到成家。
lines.en: In this trade, we do not live long enough to settle.

lines.zh: 别问，我的同伴都倒在堡垒门口。
lines.en: Do not ask; my companions fell at the fortress gate.

lines.zh: 架子空着，正好装我的骨灰。
lines.en: The rack is empty, just right to carry my ashes.

lines.zh: 我捡起一支断箭，插回架子的钩上。
lines.en: I pick up a broken arrow and hang it on a hook.

lines.zh: 金粒掉在地上，我弯腰很慢。
lines.en: Gold nuggets hit the floor, and I bend down slowly.

lines.zh: 这张盾牌还能用，我挂到背后。
lines.en: This shield still works, so I sling it on my back.

lines.zh: 我捡的不是战利品，是能换的钱。
lines.en: I am not picking loot; I am picking trade goods.

lines.zh: 地上有块熟猪排，我不碰。
lines.en: There is a cooked porkchop on the ground; I leave it.

lines.zh: 我把断掉的剑尖收进架子。
lines.en: I tuck the broken sword tip into my rack.

lines.zh: 你掉的箭，我替你捡起来。
lines.en: The arrow you dropped, I pick it up for you.

lines.zh: 一块金锭，够换三支好箭。
lines.en: One gold ingot buys three decent arrows.

lines.zh: 我捡起石头，砸了砸盾牌的凹处。
lines.en: I pick up a stone and hammer out the shield's dent.

lines.zh: 我不会捡同伴的骨头。
lines.en: I will not pick up the bones of my own comrades.

lines.zh: 有猪灵的弩瞄着我，我转身。
lines.en: A piglin crossbow aims at me, so I turn around.

lines.zh: 那支箭扎进架子，我记住了射手。
lines.en: That arrow hit my rack, and I remember the shooter.

lines.zh: 我看见一个落单的猪灵，金剑出鞘。
lines.en: I spot a lone piglin and draw my gold sword.

lines.zh: 你手里的金子，让我改变了主意。
lines.en: The gold in your hand changes my mind.

lines.zh: 前面有脚步声，不是蹄子。
lines.en: Footsteps ahead, and they are not hooves.

lines.zh: 我的瞎眼那边有动静，我侧过去。
lines.en: Something moves on my blind side, so I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 猪灵蛮兵在追谁？我跟上看看。
lines.en: Who is the brute chasing? I will follow and see.

lines.zh: 目标不高，但跑得很快。
lines.en: The target is not tall, but it runs fast.

lines.zh: 我松开盾牌，握紧金剑。
lines.en: I loosen my shield grip and tighten my hold on the gold sword.

lines.zh: 弩声一响，我就知道该打谁。
lines.en: One crossbow twang, and I know who to fight.

lines.zh: 你偷了我的钩子，还站在那。
lines.en: You stole my hook, and you are still standing there.

lines.zh: 骨头马喷了口气，它也看见了。
lines.en: The bone horse snorts; it has seen you too.

lines.zh: 我抬起金剑，架子上的铁片叮当。
lines.en: I raise my gold sword, and the iron on my rack clinks.

lines.zh: 这座堡垒里，先动手的才算猎人。
lines.en: In this fortress, whoever strikes first earns the name hunter.

lines.zh: 有个持弩的，正瞄着这边的猪灵。
lines.en: A crossbow is aimed at the piglin over there.

lines.zh: 我一只眼盯着你，另一只盯着门。
lines.en: One eye stays on you, the other on the door.

lines.zh: 你往左跑，我的瞎眼在右边。
lines.en: You run left, and my blind eye faces right.

lines.zh: 我不追快，只追不换方向的人。
lines.en: I do not chase speed, only those who never turn.

lines.zh: 金剑举着，我一步步压过去。
lines.en: Gold sword raised, I press forward one step at a time.

lines.zh: 你躲进柱子后，我绕到另一边。
lines.en: You hide behind a pillar, and I circle the other way.

lines.zh: 骨头马的蹄声替我数拍子。
lines.en: The bone horse's hooves keep time for me.

lines.zh: 我把盾牌举高，挡住你的视线。
lines.en: I raise my shield high to block your line of sight.

lines.zh: 你射我一箭，我就记住这个角度。
lines.en: You shoot me once, and I remember that angle.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊会惊动蛮兵。
lines.en: I do not shout; shouting would alert the brutes.

lines.zh: 我早知道尽头是堵死墙。
lines.en: I already know the corridor ends in a dead wall.

lines.zh: 你回头看我的瞎眼，那是个错误。
lines.en: You looked back at my blind eye, and that was a mistake.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚印，一步不落。
lines.en: I follow your footprints without missing a single one.

lines.zh: 架子上的钩子刮墙，像在倒数。
lines.en: My hooks scrape the wall like a countdown.

lines.zh: 你喘得比我厉害，猎人听得出来。
lines.en: You are breathing harder than I am; a hunter can tell.

lines.zh: 你踩着我的影子过来了。
lines.en: You walked right over my shadow.

lines.zh: 我把金剑放低，你反而更近。
lines.en: I lower the gold sword and you come closer.

lines.zh: 我绕到骨头马后面，你追不上。
lines.en: I slip behind the skeletal horse. You can't follow.

lines.zh: 你换手的空档，我记下了。
lines.en: I marked the gap when you switch hands.

lines.zh: 金剑斜劈，削掉你袖子一角。
lines.en: My gold sword slashes and clips the corner of your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我用盾牌撞你的胸口。
lines.en: I drive my shield straight into your chest.

lines.zh: 这一剑不重，但我砍了两下。
lines.en: That cut was light, so I landed a second one.

lines.zh: 你挡开金剑，盾牌却砸在你腕上。
lines.en: You parry the gold sword, but my shield hits your wrist.

lines.zh: 我瞎眼那边的空档，被你抓到了。
lines.en: You found the gap on my blind side.

lines.zh: 金剑砍在石头上，卷了刃。
lines.en: My gold sword bites stone and rolls its edge.

lines.zh: 我把你顶到墙边，架子吱吱响。
lines.en: I pin you against the wall, and the rack creaks.

lines.zh: 这一下是替架子上的钩子讨的。
lines.en: That blow was for the hooks on my rack.

lines.zh: 你退，我就再进一步。
lines.en: You retreat, and I take another step forward.

lines.zh: 我不停手，猎人只算结果。
lines.en: I do not stop swinging; a hunter counts only results.

lines.zh: 你格挡的姿势不错，可惜慢了。
lines.en: Your guard stance is decent, but it is slow.

lines.zh: 骨头马在后面踢了你一脚。
lines.en: The bone horse kicks you from behind.

lines.zh: 我一剑砍空，鼻环磕在你肩甲上。
lines.en: I miss the swing, and my nose ring clangs on your shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 你流汗了，我闻得见。
lines.en: You are sweating, and I can smell it.

lines.zh: 金剑贴着你耳朵过去。
lines.en: The gold sword passes by your ear.

lines.zh: 我撞开你的盾，再补一剑。
lines.en: I bash the shield aside and add a cut.

lines.zh: 我从堡垒的哨位上醒过来。
lines.en: I wake up at my watch post in the fortress.

lines.zh: 架子先落地，我才站稳。
lines.en: The rack lands first, and then I find my feet.

lines.zh: 骨头马在身后嘶叫，它跟我一起来的。
lines.en: The bone horse shrieks behind me; it came along.

lines.zh: 瞎眼那侧的风先吹到我脸上。
lines.en: The wind on my blind side reaches my face first.

lines.zh: 金剑还在鞘里，我抽出来试了试。
lines.en: My gold sword is still sheathed; I draw it and test the weight.

lines.zh: 我的钩子上挂着上一任的骨头。
lines.en: The bones of my predecessor hang from my hooks.

lines.zh: 黑石路上多了一串蹄印。
lines.en: A new set of hoofprints appears on the blackstone road.

lines.zh: 我背着架子，从熔岩坡上走下来。
lines.en: I carry my rack down the lava slope.

lines.zh: 猪灵蛮兵看了我一眼，没说话。
lines.en: A piglin brute glances at me and says nothing.

lines.zh: 这只眼是新的，那只早就没了。
lines.en: This eye is new; the other one was lost long ago.

lines.zh: 我在门口站定，开始等猎物。
lines.en: I take my place at the gate and begin waiting for game.

lines.zh: 架子的影子先一步铺在地上。
lines.en: The rack's shadow spreads across the ground before me.

lines.zh: 有人敲了钟，我就来了。
lines.en: Someone rang the bell, so here I am.

lines.zh: 我数了数箭，够用一阵。
lines.en: I count my arrows; there are enough for a while.

lines.zh: 火苗舔过架子，木头先焦了。
lines.en: Flames lick across my rack, and the wood chars first.

lines.zh: 从黑石坡滚下去，架子散了半边。
lines.en: I roll down the blackstone slope, and half my rack breaks apart.

lines.zh: 水漫过鼻环，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Water rises past my nose ring, and I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻架子，钩子飞了一地。
lines.en: The blast throws my rack over, scattering hooks everywhere.

lines.zh: 又一支箭，射穿了我肩上的皮带。
lines.en: Another arrow punches through the strap on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 药水味冲进瞎眼那边，更看不见了。
lines.en: Potion fumes flood my blind side, and I see even less.

lines.zh: 猎人也会饿，我两天没换到肉。
lines.en: Even hunters get hungry; two days without trading for meat.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的金剑上，手臂发麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my gold sword, and my arm goes numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有猎物，我不喜欢。
lines.en: There is no game in the void, and I do not like it.
